title: Evaluate and remediate ARIA announcements and contrast for inline editors & floating toolbar overlays
creator: Ava Thompson
description:
Scope
- Audit all inline editing surfaces and floating/toolbars overlays across the design system (table cell inline editors, chart annotation editors, comment/notes popovers, and ephemeral action toolbars).
- Identify ARIA misuses and missing announcements (aria-live, role, aria-controls, aria-expanded) that prevent screen reader users from reliably discovering and interacting with ephemeral editors.
- Validate color contrast for toolbar buttons, badge counters, and focus outlines across light/dark/high-contrast themes.
- Propose remediations that preserve visual density while meeting AA/AAA contrast where feasible and provide VPAT evidence for the changes.

Out of scope
- Full rewrite of the inline editor UX or data model changes. Engineering-owned runtime batching changes. Separate tickets will track heavy infra or runtime changes.

Acceptance criteria
- All identified inline editors and toolbars have a documented ARIA pattern or annotated Figma component that includes roles and aria-live usage.
- Keyboard flow for open/close/edit/cancel is consistent: Tab to activate, Enter to begin edit, Esc to cancel and return focus to invoking control, and explicit focus trapping when appropriate.
- Color contrast improvements meet WCAG AA for normal text and AA/AAA for icons where required by VPAT path. Provide before/after contrast ratios.
- A VPAT annex entry (evidence snippets and test instructions) is prepared for legal/compliance referencing these components.
- A minimal set of CSS tokens and focus styles are proposed and merged to design-system token library with migration notes.

Design trade-offs and notes
- We will avoid increasing visual footprint for inline editors where possible; preference for stronger focus ring + subtle background over larger borders. For some small icon-only toolbar items we will introduce a subtle filled focus state at 3:1 contrast to preserve density while still giving clear affordance.
- Some legacy chart annotation editors will require small markup changes for role placement; those will be handled in paired ENG tickets.

Testing plan
- Run automated a11y scans (axe-core) against Storybook stories for each affected component.
- Manual screen reader pass (NVDA + VoiceOver) with a checklist of discovery scenarios (open toolbar, start editing inline cell, commit/cancel flows).
- Contrast checks using Spectacles for tokenized themes.

Deliverables
- Figma tokens and component annotations updated with ARIA guidance (link in 'links' below).
- PR(s) in design-system repo with CSS token updates and small component patches.
- VPAT annex document with test evidence and conformance table snippets.
